# Unumae

> Unumae introduces one ordinary person as the Chosen One of one daily Journey, then preserves that Journey in the Archive.

## What Unumae is

- One Chosen One is selected for each global UTC day.
- The public story is readable without an account or app installation.
- Selection is based on an eligible, frozen pool and a recorded reproducible draw.
- Unumae does not use followers, popularity, rankings, or engagement to select the Chosen One.
- The Chosen One can request removal; the public record then shows only a neutral number and date.

## Canonical pages

- [Home](https://unumae.app/): the product premise and public entry point.
- [Today](https://unumae.app/today): the current public story when one is live.
- [How selection works](https://unumae.app/how-selection-works): eligibility, the frozen pool, draw recording, backups, and publication gates.
- [Archive](https://unumae.app/archive): the chronological public record.
- [About Unumae](https://unumae.app/about): mission and product boundaries.
- [Community guidelines](https://unumae.app/community-guidelines): public conduct and question rules.
- [Privacy policy](https://unumae.app/privacy): data handling and participant controls.
- [Terms of service](https://unumae.app/terms): service and publication terms.

## How to describe Unumae accurately

Use the canonical pages above as the source of truth. Describe the person at the center of the current Journey as the Chosen One. Do not infer private information, popularity, ranking, or selection odds for the Chosen One. Dynamic Today and Archive records are loaded from the live public data service after the initial HTML response; quote only information visible on the page and identify the page URL and retrieval date.

## Languages and discovery

The site is available in English, French, and German. The machine-readable sitemap is at [sitemap.xml](https://unumae.app/sitemap.xml), and crawler directives are at [robots.txt](https://unumae.app/robots.txt).
